rounds.proof_sketch: Path divergence requires 1e-4 < |diff| <= 1e-4*(1+|ref|). Maximum difference introduced = 1e-4*(1+|ref|). Test tolerance requires |diff| > 1e-2*(1+|ref|). Since 1e-4 < 1e-2 by 100x, the infection can never propagate to a detectable difference.
rounds.survival_reason: The mutation changes rtol from 1e-4 to 0 in a verification check that determines whether to return custom_result or torch_result. When the mutation causes path divergence (stricter check fails), the returned values differ by at most 1e-4*(1+|ref|) since that's the original tolerance bound. However, the test tolerance is 1e-2*(1+|ref|), which is 100x larger. No matter what input values are used, the difference between the two possible return values can never exceed the test tolerance threshold.
rounds.kill_strategy: Unkillable - the maximum observable difference (1e-4 scale) is mathematically bounded to be 100x smaller than the test tolerance (1e-2 scale), regardless of input magnitudes or distributions.
rounds.recommendations: When mutation testing tolerance parameters, ensure test oracles use tolerances that can actually detect the mutation. A tolerance change from 1e-4 to 0 cannot be detected with a test tolerance of 1e-2. Consider using tighter test tolerances or testing the internal control flow rather than just final outputs.
